posts.text:
Given today, it is surprising how daring Microsoft & Google were initially with AI.

Microsoft released GPT-4 before OpenAI, didn't back down after Sydney & got Copilot to market quickly (the 1st professional AI tool)

Google dealt with blowback about Bard and AI Overview and invented deep research.

posts.text:
I continue to think that a lack of verifiable answers in many fields is a real issue for LLMs but not as big a problem as it sometimes is made out to be.

As models are improving at formal domains, they also are Improving at lots of other less-verifiable domains as well, though jaggedness remains.
posts.summary: LLM verification issues overstated relative to actual capability gains

posts.text: One other observation: for almost every human on the planet, this is not just beyond our abilities but beyond our ken. We can only trust expert mathematicians to tell us if this is impressive, This is starting to happen across many fields making capability gains hard to “feel” without deep expertise

One big result in our study at Procter & Gamble was that AI blurred the lines between jobs. Now OpenAI has a similar finding

Organizational boundaries are becoming porous, the walls thinning. Companies are going to need to think about division of labor in a new way, things are getting chaotic now.

This time, I had Fable built me a casual Van Gogh city building game that I faked in an AI video last year.

The key mechanic the AI came up with is painting the landscape with big brushstrokes & an environment that evolves with weather and seasons.

Chill and pretty. Play it: the-sower.netlify.app

"...and that is critical to game play. figure everythign else out, make it beautiful. have agents play the game and iteratre until great. use my computer as needed"

Then I gave a couple prompts of feedback ("Make the graphics a lot better")

That is it, no special frameworks.
Codex is a bit better. But HP printers will defeat even ASI

For some reason today Steam games froze when launching. Why? Apparently the latest update of my wireless keyboard driver also got installed as an Xbox controller which conflicted with Windows joystick's legacy API controller 0.

Codex fixed it. I cannot imagine figuring it out myself at any point.
And yet they still stink at good long-form fiction.
I've been posting art-inspired city builders
